source.author: ov
source.text: causa ratis superest: Tuscum rate venit in amnem ante pererrato falcifer orbe deus.
source.text_original: causa ratis superest: Tuscum rate venit in amnem / ante pererrato falcifer orbe deus.
source.text_english: The reason for the raft remains: the sickle-bearing god came by raft into the Tuscan river after first wandering through the world.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: fugit igitur expulsus et in italiam nauigio uenit, cum errasset diu, sicut Ouidius Fastorum libris refert: causa ratis superest.
reuse.text_original: fugit igitur expulsus et in italiam nauigio uenit, cum errasset diu, sicut Ouidius Fastorum libris refert: causa ratis superest.
reuse.text_english: So he fled when driven out and came by ship to Italy, after wandering for a long time, as Ovid relates in the Fasti: the cause of the raft remains.
